item.title: Final Audit — What Can Be Stated Responsibly in 2026?
item.lead: The strongest final version is not the most absolute version, but the version that a critical reader can verify step by step.

blocks.text: Responsible: commercial tools exist that support fan spending, purchase history, and personalization; AI systems exist that can chat in a creator's voice; journalistic investigations have documented ghost-chatting and outsourced chatter work; European regulations now include specific rules on consumer fairness, privacy, platform design, and AI transparency.

Not responsible without new evidence: that a majority of the sector uses psychological vulnerabilities as a "weapon"; that microtransactions systematically constitute a money laundering scheme; that adult-tech causes the decline in fertility; or that a coordinated system deliberately produces societal paranoia.

Responsible as a hypothesis: that the combination of CRM, segmentation, automated messaging, and hidden human/AI replacement can create a new form of commercial asymmetry. This is precisely the hypothesis that a subsequent empirical study should test.

blocks.label: FINAL CRITERION
blocks.text: Every strong claim must be able to lead a reader to a concrete document, log, dataset, or reproducible method.
